post.description:
Confirm the chosen products and amounts. Validio asks Valio again for every price, the
agent's numbers are never read.

Answer the kitchen's pairing code with the agent's name and public P-256 key. The kitchen then
sees the consent screen.

get.description: Poll with the pairing code: consent (still waiting), allowed (with the Spend Pass) or denied.

Products from Valio's catalog with graded claims. Static data only, no live call.
Supplier text sits in descriptionUntrusted and is never used for a decision.

post.description:
Text or typed lines in, ranked options and the Hard Lines decision out. A retry with the
same idempotency key returns the same request.
The demo kitchen: the copy this browser already has, or a fresh one from the template.
A one-time link, valid 10 minutes, that logs a phone into this account and opens `path`.

get.description: Every request and Steady Order, newest first. `counts` count all items, whatever the filter.

A request (R-…) or a Steady Order (S-…). Approve and reject stay POST /api/orders/{orderId}/approve and
/reject with `approval.orderId`.

post.description:
Back to the state `make demo` starts from: drops every table, seeds again. A demo copy goes back to the
template, or with {"fresh": true} to the plain seed with no agent connected.

get.description:
Home in one call. `week.usedCents` is what placed orders under the Rules' pass add up to, `capCents` the
Rules' per week limit (null without one).
The signed head: entry count, last hash and the time of the last entry, signed with the kitchen's key.

post.description:
Approve a waiting order. Validio asks Valio again and refuses if a price rose more than 2 %, a
line can no longer be delivered, the cut-off or the deadline has passed or the Spend Pass is no
longer valid. A placed order cannot be approved twice.
Trade the kitchen token for a cookie, so the web app need not send the header itself.

put.description: A new email, a new password, or both, with the current password. Demo copies have no login.

post.description:
The owner signs Spend Pass M-1 again with new limits. Same id and validity window, so what the week
already placed still counts against a per week limit; the copy the agent held before is refused from now on. One ledger entry.

get.description:
M-1 as the kitchen signed it last; any other pass as the agent last showed it. Fields it does not
disclose stay absent.
